{{nihongo|'''Hachita Shrine'''|蜂田神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izumi Province]].

'''Hachita Shrine''' (はちたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Hattadera-chō, {{ill|Naka-ku, Sakai|Q1042487|qid=Q1042487|lt=Naka-ku}}, {{ill|Sakai|Q193428|qid=Q193428}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} (small), and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. It is also called '''Suzu-no-Miya'''.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Main deity - {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}
* Associated deities - {{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|Q382005|qid=Q382005}}, {{ill|Kanayama-hiko and Kanayama-hime|es|Kanayamahiko y Kanayamahime|ja|金山彦神|pl|Kanayamahiko|zh|金山毘古神|qid=Q4387856|lt=Kanayamahiko-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Izanami|Q682306|qid=Q682306|lt=Izanami-no-Mikoto}}

=== History ===
The exact founding year is unknown, but it is said that the Hachita no Muraji clan who lived in this area worshiped their ancestor {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}} as deity. A tale says the Hachita no Muraji made 12 {{ill|dorei|ja|土鈴|pl|Dorei|qid=Q9210104|lt=fired-clay bells}} and offered them each spring, divining that year's fortune by their sound quality; from this it was also called Suzu-no-Miya<ref name="蜂田神社">[https://www.sakai-tcb.or.jp/spot/detail/130 Sakai Tourism Guide Hachita Shrine]</ref>. It is also a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} of {{ill|Ōtori district|Q3270651|qid=Q3270651}} in {{ill|Izumi Province|ca|Província d'Izumi|ckb|پارێزگای ئیزومی|cs|Provincie Izumi|de|Provinz Izumi|es|Provincia de Izumi|fa|ولایت ایزومی|fr|Province d'Izumi|gl|Provincia de Izumi|hak|Izumi-koet|id|Provinsi Izumi|it|Izumi (provincia)|ja|和泉国|ko|이즈미국|lt|Idzumio žemė|nl|Izumi (provincie)|pt|Província de Izumi|ru|Идзуми (провинция)|simple|Izumi Province|sk|Izumi (provincia)|sr|Провинција Изуми|tr|Izumi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ідзумі|zh|和泉國|zh_min_nan|Izumi-kok|zh_yue|和泉國|qid=Q1047117}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}<ref name="蜂田神社"/>.

In early modern times, Seirin-ji existed as its {{ill|Jingū-ji|Q1074971|qid=Q1074971}}, but in the {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} era it was abolished due to {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|Q1970535|qid=Q1970535}}<ref name="由緒書"/>. The shrine was ranked {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

In {{ill|1910|Q2075|qid=Q2075}} (Meiji 43), it merged six nearby village shrines and two unranked shrines<ref name="由緒書"/>.

=== Wind-bell festival ===
Held from July 1 to August 31. About 1,300 wind bells, including Edo, Kawachi, and Nambu styles, ring clear sounds through the precincts<ref name="風鈴祭り">[https://www.city.sakai.lg.jp/naka/miryoku/nakaku_machikado/hachita-jinja.html Sakai City website: Wind-bell festival at Hachita Shrine (Suzu-no-Miya)]</ref>.

=== Location ===
* 524 Hattadera-chō, Naka-ku, Sakai, Osaka

=== Access ===
* From {{ill|Fukai Station|arz|محطة فوكاى|ja|深井駅|ko|후카이역|my|ဖုခိုင်ဘူတာ|nl|Station Fukai|ur|فوکائی اسٹیشن|zh|深井站 (日本)|qid=Q5507572}} on the {{ill|Semboku Line|fr|Ligne Nankai Semboku|id|Kereta Cepat Semboku|it|Linea ferroviaria rapida Senboku|ja|南海泉北線|ko|난카이 센보쿠선|nl|Semboku-lijn|zh|泉北線|qid=Q2758012}}, take {{ill|Nankai Bus|Q11408154|qid=Q11408154}} bound for Tsukuno Station and get off at "Suzu-no-Miya Danchi Higashiguchi," then about 5 minutes on foot
